name: What are the typical steps involved in an AI website optimization project?
description: Key steps include site audit, identifying semantic opportunities, content and technical refinement, implementation, and continuous monitoring.

mainEntity.name: What are the typical steps involved in an AI website optimization project?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI website optimization project typically begins with a comprehensive audit of your existing website, analyzing content, technical structure, and current AI visibility. Next, we focus on identifying key entities, semantic gaps, and opportunities for content enrichment that align with AI understanding. This often involves refining content for clarity, structuring data with schema markup, and ensuring mobile-first indexing. We then implement these changes, monitor performance using AI-driven analytics, and iterate based on new data and algorithm updates to maintain optimal visibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key steps include site audit, identifying semantic opportunities, content and technical refinement, implementation, and continuous monitoring.
